records.jp: どうよこれ。<CR>ジュークボックス的な？
records.en_original: What do you think? It's like a jukebox!
records.en: What do you think? It's like a jukebox!

records.jp: また変なこと考えて
records.en_original: Again with your crazy ideas.
records.en: Again with your crazy ideas.

records.jp: 結構実用的なんだよ？
records.en_original: I think it's actually pretty practical.
records.en: I think it's actually pretty practical.

records.jp: 設定すればこの部屋だけかけるとかできるし。<CR>好きな曲を爆音で聞き放題
records.en_original: You can set it to only play in this room. Then you can listen to your favorite songs at full blast!
records.en: You can set it to only play in this room. Then you can listen to your favorite songs at full blast!

records.jp: 個室で……好きな曲を聞き放題……
records.en_original: A private listening room...
records.en: A private listening room...

records.jp: 聞きたい曲でもあるの？
records.en_original: Is there a song you'd wanna listen to?
records.en: Is there a song you'd wanna listen to?

records.jp: いや別に
records.en_original: Not really.
records.en: Not really.

records.jp: 興味ありそうな顔してたから
records.en_original: Your face lit up for a moment.
records.en: Your face lit up for a moment.

records.jp: 誰にも邪魔されないで楽しめるのはいいなって<CR>思っただけ
records.en_original: I like the idea of not being disturbed by anyone, that's all.
records.en: I like the idea of not being disturbed by anyone, that's all.

records.jp: ふーん
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: マイクもあるし、カラオケ大会もできるよ
records.en_original: There are mics too. We could have a karaoke party!
records.en: There are mics too. We could have a karaoke party!

records.jp: カラオケ……
records.en_original: Karaoke...
records.en: Karaoke...

records.jp: あ、カラオケ好き？<CR>一緒にやる？
records.en_original: Oh, do you like karaoke? Wanna sing something together?
records.en: Oh, do you like karaoke? Wanna sing something together?

records.jp: いい、大丈夫
records.en_original: I'll pass.
records.en: I'll pass.

records.jp: あ、そう？<CR>意外と興味あるのかと思った
records.en_original: Really? For some reason I thought you'd like karaoke.
records.en: Really? For some reason I thought you'd like karaoke.

records.jp: まぁ、校内放送で使えたら便利だろうし、<CR>操作には慣れておこうかな
records.en_original: Well either way, it'll be useful for making announcements. I might as well get used to the controls.
records.en: Well either way, it'll be useful for making announcements. I might as well get used to the controls.

records.jp: 星崎さん、リクエストある？
records.en_original: Any requests, Hoshizaki?
records.en: Any requests, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: クラシックで
records.en_original: Classical music.
records.en: Classical music.

records.jp: 星崎さんって、クラシック好きだっけ
records.en_original: Since when do you like classical music, Hoshizaki?
records.en: Since when do you like classical music, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: っていうより、大体どの学校にも<CR>それなりに置いてるかなって
records.en_original: I don't, really. I just figured most schools would have a pretty decent selection of it.
records.en: I don't, really. I just figured most schools would have a pretty decent selection of it.

records.jp: なるほどね。<CR>放送の時もそういう曲をかければ無難か
records.en_original: I see. I guess it's always a safe choice.
records.en: I see. I guess it's always a safe choice.

records.jp: 雅楽で
records.en_original: Gagaku.
records.en: Gagaku.

records.jp: ほ、星崎さんってそういうの好きなの？
records.en_original: Traditional Japanese court music? I didn't know you were into that, Hoshizaki.
records.en: Traditional Japanese court music? I didn't know you were into that, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 校内に雅楽流れてたら、みやびじゃない？
records.en_original: Don't you think it would sound beautiful echoing through the halls of the school?
records.en: Don't you think it would sound beautiful echoing through the halls of the school?

records.jp: 驚かしたいだけでしょ
records.en_original: You just want to surprise everyone, don't you?
records.en: You just want to surprise everyone, don't you?

records.jp: えへへへ
records.en_original: Teeheehee!
records.en: Teeheehee!

records.jp: で、ＣＤは……
records.en_original: Well, we'll need a CD...
records.en: Well, we'll need a CD...

records.jp: ああ、私が取ってくる
records.en_original: Ah, I'll go and get one.
records.en: Ah, I'll go and get one.

records.jp: （でもここで宣言通りのものを<CR>持ってきても面白くないよね）
records.en_original: (Maybe I should mix things up a bit, though...)
records.en: (Maybe I should mix things up a bit, though...)

records.jp: （よし、アニソンにしよう）
records.en_original: (All right, anime theme songs it is!)
records.en: (All right, anime theme songs it is!)

records.jp: ちょっと待って。<CR>これさっき言ってたのと違うでしょ
records.en_original: Wait a minute, this isn't what you said you'd bring!
records.en: Wait a minute, this isn't what you said you'd bring!

records.jp: んー？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ＣＤの表面にいかにもな紋様が入ってたんだけど
records.en_original: The CD cover is quite distinctive.
records.en: The CD cover is quite distinctive.

records.jp: 「屍神の法則」の主題歌だよ。<CR>ジャケットが普通だからバレないかと思ったんだけど
records.en_original: It's the theme song to The Death God Theory. The cover is kinda plain, so I didn't think you'd notice.
records.en: It's the theme song to The Death God Theory. The cover is kinda plain, so I didn't think you'd notice.

records.jp: そんなんじゃ騙されないから
records.en_original: You'll have to try harder than that if you want to fool me.
records.en: You'll have to try harder than that if you want to fool me.

records.jp: へー、詳しいね
records.en_original: Ooh, I didn't know you were a fan.
records.en: Ooh, I didn't know you were a fan.

records.jp: いや勘だから！　勘！
records.en_original: It was just a hunch! A hunch...!
records.en: It was just a hunch! A hunch...!

records.jp: （よし、ドラマＣＤにしよう）
records.en_original: (Let's go with the ASMR recording.)
records.en: (Let's go with the ASMR recording.)

records.jp: なんか足音が流れてきたんだけど。<CR>どういうこと？
records.en_original: I hear footsteps... What's going on?
records.en: I hear footsteps... What's going on?

records.jp: ドラマＣＤだからねぇ。<CR>お姉さんが耳かきしてくれるやつ
records.en_original: Yeah, it's one of those ASMR recordings. You know, where a cute girl whispers in your ear?
records.en: Yeah, it's one of those drama CDs where a onee-san cleans your ears.

records.jp: 早く言いなさいよそれを！
records.en_original: Why didn't you tell me?!
records.en: Why didn't you tell me?!

records.jp: ふう、危なかった
records.en_original: Whew, that was close.
records.en: Whew, that was close.

records.jp: いいじゃん。<CR>この部屋にしか流れない設定にしてたんだしー
records.en_original: It's fine! It was only playing in this room.
records.en: It's fine! It was only playing in this room.

records.jp: よくない！　密室で二人きりで耳かきボイス聴くって<CR>どういう拷問！？
records.en_original: It's not fine! Being forced to listen to ASMR while locked in a room with you?! That's torture!
records.en: It's not fine! Being forced to listen to ASMR while locked in a room with you?! That's torture!

records.jp: 耳かきボイス嫌い？
records.en_original: You don't like how it sounds?
records.en: You don't like how it sounds?

records.jp: そういうことじゃなくて、こういう時に<CR>聞くものじゃないでしょって言ってるの！
records.en_original: That's not the point! This is neither the time nor place!
records.en: That's not the point! This is neither the time nor place!

records.jp: はーい
records.en_original: Fine...
records.en: Fine...

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
